title: Newsprint
logline: The strip is in a newspaper. Three coastal weeklies. Wood reads it at Gully's beside the tide tables.

panels.composition: Gully's. A stack of the Newport weekly on the counter. GULLY holding one open. WOOD on the stool, not looking, looking.

characters.pose: on the stool, pretending not to look

balloons.text: Page fourteen. Next to the tides.

image.prompt: a man in an apron holding a local weekly newspaper open at a bait-and-espresso counter, a young man on the end stool pretending not to look, a stack of newspapers, muddy digital flats

panels.composition: Page fourteen: the tide table on the left, DRIFT WOOD on the right, a week old, on newsprint, the dot gain fattening the line. Wood's line, in a newspaper.
props: newspaper page: tide table and the strip

image.notes: The strip on newsprint next to the tide tables. Draw the dot gain.

panels.composition: Wood, holding the paper now. Not saying anything. Gully watching him not say anything.

panels.composition: Wood pinning page fourteen to the corkboard, over the parody printout. Gully lets him.
